title: Sweet Dorayaki Chicken Drumsticks
description: Crunchy chicken drumsticks smothered in a sweet dorayaki-inspired teriyaki sauce, perfect for a quick Japanese-style dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 2 tablespoons rice vinegar, and 1 tablespoon sesame oil. Blend until smooth.
Add 1-2 dorayaki to the blender and blend until well combined.
Place the chicken drumsticks in a large bowl and pour the dorayaki sauce over them. Toss to coat.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper and spray with cooking spray. Arrange the chicken drumsticks on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, toast the dorayaki slices in a toaster or under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Once the chicken is done, brush the dorayaki slices with a little water and place them on top of the chicken drumsticks.
Sprinkle with green onions and serve hot.
Garnish with additional green onions and dorayaki slices, if desired.
